title: OCR Confidence by Journal Source
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:journal journal_source=* ocr_confidence_pct=*
| stats avg(ocr_confidence_pct) as avg_ocr_confidence_pct, count as events by journal_source
| sort - avg_ocr_confidence_pct
description: Shows average OCR confidence percentage by journal source for journal OCR quality.
value: Average OCR confidence percentage by journal source helps compare journal OCR quality across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `ocr_confidence_pct` on `memory:journal` events and normalize `journal_source` so Splunk can summarize performance by journal source.
visualization: Bar chart of average OCR confidence percentage by journal source.
grandmaExplanation: It totals the average OCR confidence percentage for each journal source so you can see what works best for journal OCR quality.
